extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: railway handcar (pump trolley), 2.5 m long, 2.1 m wide, 1.9 m high on its own 4.0 m straight track piece, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y. The handcar stands on the rail top of the included track piece (ballast bottom z = 0, rail top 0.30 m, track ends at y = -2.0 and +2.0 like the railway-track module, so it can replace a straight piece). Movable: the wooden pump lever with two T handles is the separate object 'handcar_lever', origin on the pivot axis (x +0.000, y +0.000, z +2.020 m from the model origin, Z up); rotate about the Blender X axis (glTF X), about +-15 deg for pumping. Red frame, plank deck, two wheelsets in axle boxes, gear drive, toolbox and an emissive front lamp; wheels are part of the mesh

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
